blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Basic Separation Techniques) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. After the crystals are formed, they are typically separated from the mother liquor by:
(Crystals ban jane ke baad unhein mother liquor (bacha hua mehlool) se aam tor par kaise alag kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crystallization mukammal hone par crystals aur mother liquor ko filter kiya jata hai (vacuum pump ke saath Gooch crucible se) (15.4.1); liquid ko upar se undel kar (decantation) bhi alag kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
II. The comparative rates at which the solutes move in paper chromatography depend on:
(Paper chromatography mein solutes ke chalne ki rafttar ka muqabla kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har component ka apna retardation factor hai: Rf = component ka tay kiya faasla ÷ solvent ka tay kiya faasla. Zyada Rf ka matlab hai solute tez chalta hai (15.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
III. The method that can be used to separate two solid compounds with different solubilities in a solvent is:
(Kisi solvent mein mukhtalif solubility wale do thos compounds ko alag karne ka tareeqa kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crystallization mein thanda karne par kam hal hone wala compound crystals ban kar nikal aata hai, aur zyada hal hone wala mother liquor mein reh jata hai (15.2).

blocks.prompt:
IV. It is suspected that a hand-written legal document has been changed by over writing some crucial figures. Which technique you will use to check the inks used at suspected places?
(Shak hai ke haath se likhe qanooni kaghaz mein kuch aham hindsay oopar likh kar badle gaye hain. Mashkook jagahon ki siyahi check karne ke liye kaun si technique istemal karenge?)
blocks.explanation: Siyahi rangon (dyes) ka mixture hai; chromatography inhein alag kar ke spots aur Rf values ke muqable se pehchanti hai (15.3.4: dyes). Mukhtalif siyahiyan mukhtalif pattern deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
V. In chromatography, the components of the mixture are separated based on:
(Chromatography mein mixture ke components kis buniyad par alag hote hain?)

options.text: Components ka stationary aur mobile phases (kitab mein "phones") se talluq
Istemal hone wale solvent ki qisam

blocks.explanation: Chromatography har component ki stationary phase aur mobile phase ke darmiyan taqseem par munhasir hai; jo components mukhtalif tarah asar karte hain woh mukhtalif rafttar se chalte hain (15.3).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) mein "mobile phones" chhapa hai; murad "mobile phases" hai.

blocks.prompt:
VI. The porous material used to separate the solid from the liquid during filtration is called the:
(Filtration mein thos ko liquid se alag karne wala masaam daar maadda kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Filtration filter medium, jaise filter paper ya filter crucible, se hoti hai (15.1). Guzarne wala liquid filtrate aur peeche reh jane wala thos residue hai.

blocks.prompt:
VII. The key difference between simple distillation and fractional distillation is the presence of a:
(Simple aur fractional distillation mein bunyadi farq kis cheez ki maujoodgi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fractional distillation mein flask aur condenser ke darmiyan glass beads se bhara fractionating (distillation) column hota hai jo baar baar condense hone ke liye bari satah deta hai (15.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The essential requirement for separating two liquids by simple distillation is that their boiling points should differ by at least:
(Simple distillation se do liquids alag karne ke liye un ke boiling points mein kam az kam kitna farq zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter boiling points ke taqreeban 25 °C farq ko hadd maanta hai (15.2.1): kam az kam taqreeban 25 °C farq wale liquids simple distillation se alag ho sakte hain; is se qareeb boiling points ke liye fractionating column chahiye.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter ka jumla 25 °C ko fractional distillation ke saath likhta hai. Aam usool yeh hai: farq 25 °C se zyada ho to simple distillation, kam ho to fractional distillation.

blocks.prompt:
IX. In chromatography, a locating agent is used to:
(Chromatography mein locating agent kis liye istemal hota hai?)

options.text: Sample ko alag karne ke liye hal karna
Alag hue components ko stationary phase par aage le jana
Be-rang alag hue components ko pehchan ke liye nazar aane wala banana
Sample ko stationary phase se asar lene se rokna

blocks.explanation: Locating agent (maslan ninhydrin) be-rang cheezon jaise amino acids se react kar ke rangeen spots banata hai jo nazar aa jate hain (15.3.2).

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)
Q.2 Neeche diye gaye mukhtasar sawalon ke jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. Why is there a need to crystallize a crude product?
Kachi (crude) paidawar ko crystallize karna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Kachi paidawar mein milawat hoti hai (maslan bacha hua starting material, rangeen maadda). Crystallization use saaf karti hai: thanda karne par khalis compound crystals ban kar nikalta hai, hal hone wali milawat mother liquor mein rehti hai aur na-hal hone wali filter ho jati hai. Achhe crystals milte hain jin ki pakeezgi melting point se check hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
b. What is the function of fluted filter paper?
Fluted filter paper ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluted filter paper pankhe ki tarah baari baari oonchi neechi tehon mein mora jata hai. Is se filter karne ki satah bari hoti hai aur hawa guzarti hai, is liye conical funnel se filtration bohat tez hoti hai (15.1).

blocks.prompt:
c. What is the difference between a Gooch crucible and sintered glass crucible?
Gooch crucible aur sintered glass crucible mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono suction se tez filtration ke liye hain; sintered glass crucible ko tayyari ki zaroorat nahi.

rows: Porcelain (chini mitti) ka
Glass (sheeshe) ka
Soorakh wala painda jis par paper pulp, filter paper ya asbestos mat
Painde mein masaam daar glass disc jari hui
Istemal se pehle tayyari chahiye
Foran istemal; tayyari nahi chahiye
Zyada temperature par jalaye jane wale precipitates; asbestos ke saath paper ko kharab karne wale liquids (conc. HCl, KMnO₄)
Aam suction filtration

blocks.prompt:
d. What type of mixtures are filtered through a Gooch crucible?
Gooch crucible se kis qisam ke mixtures filter kiye jate hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Woh precipitates jinhein filtration ke baad zyada temperature par jalana (tez garam karna) ho.
2. Soorakhon par asbestos mat ke saath: woh mehlool jo paper se react karte hain, maslan concentrated HCl aur KMnO₄.
Suction se crystals ko mother liquor se alag karne mein bhi istemal hota hai (15.1, 15.4.1).

blocks.prompt:
e. What is function of fractionating column during fractional distillation?
Fractional distillation mein fractionating column ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Glass beads se bhara column bari satah deta hai jis par oopar uthti bhaap baar baar condense aur dobara bhaap banti hai. Zyada volatile (kam boiling point wala) liquid oopar pohanch kar pehle distil hota hai, kam volatile wapas neeche behta hai, is liye qareeb boiling points wale do miscible liquids alag ho jate hain (maslan ethanol 78 °C aur paani 100 °C; petroleum ke fractions).

blocks.prompt:
f. What is the stationary phase in the paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography mein stationary phase kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase chromatography paper ke cellulose fibres mein qaid paani hai. Paper sirf sahara hai; mobile phase aam tor par organic solvent hai jo is paani mein nahi milta (15.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
g. What will happen during paper chromatography if the components of the mixture have a comparable attraction for the stationary phase?
Agar mixture ke components ki stationary phase se kashish barabar ho to paper chromatography mein kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Woh dono phases mein ek jaisi taqseem honge, taqreeban ek rafttar se chalenge aur un ki Rf values qareeb qareeb barabar hongi. Spots ek doosre par aa jayenge, is liye components alag nahi honge; koi aur solvent azmana parega.

blocks.prompt:
h. What is the meant by the term “developing the chromatogram” in paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography mein "developing the chromatogram" ki istelah se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Developing woh amal hai jis mein solvent (mobile phase) paper mein oopar chadhta hai aur components spots ki shakal mein alag hote hain; sookha hua pattern chromatogram hai. Agar spots be-rang hon to unhein UV lamp ke neeche ya ninhydrin jaisa locating agent chhirak kar nazar aane wala banaya jata hai; yeh bhi chromatogram develop karna hai (15.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
i. What is the basic principle of paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography ka bunyadi usool kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Paper chromatography partition chromatography hai: mixture ka har component stationary phase (paper mein qaid paani) aur mobile phase (organic solvent) ke darmiyan taqseem hota hai. Mobile phase mein zyada hal hone wale components tez chalte hain; stationary phase se zyada chipakne wale dheere, is liye woh mukhtalif Rf values ke saath alag ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
j. Why water is not generally used as a solvent in paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography mein aam tor par paani solvent kyun nahi hota?
blocks.explanation: Stationary phase khud paper ke cellulose fibres mein qaid paani hai. Mobile phase is se na milne wala (immiscible) hona chahiye taake solutes do mukhtalif phases mein taqseem hon. Paani stationary paani se mil jata, is liye taqseem (partition) aur alag hona na hota.

blocks.prompt:
k. Differentiate between adsorption and partition chromatography.
Adsorption aur partition chromatography mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Farq stationary phase ki qisam mein hai: adsorption mein thos, partition chromatography mein liquid.

rows: Stationary phase thos hai
Stationary phase liquid hai (inert thos par patli tah)
Cheezein mobile phase chhor kar thos ki satah par chipak jati hain (adsorb)
Cheezein stationary aur mobile dono phases mein taqseem hoti hain
Misalein: thin layer chromatography (TLC), column chromatography
Misalein: paper chromatography, gas liquid chromatography

blocks.prompt:
l. How can you check the purity of a compound with the help of paper chromatography?
Paper chromatography se compound ki pakeezgi kaise check karenge?
blocks.explanation: Compound ka spot usi cheez ke khalis sample ke saath laga kar chromatogram chalayein. Khalis cheez sirf ek spot deti hai, jis ki Rf value khalis sample jitni ho. Milawati cheez ek se zyada spots deti hai (15.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
m. You have prepared a solid sample of glucosazone in the laboratory. How will you proceed to check the purity of the sample?
Aap ne lab mein glucosazone ka thos sample banaya hai. Is ki pakeezgi kaise check karenge?
blocks.explanation:
(Glucosazone khud chapter se aage hai; thos ke liye chapter ke tareeqe lagte hain.)
1. Melting point: crystals sukha kar melting point maloom karein. Khalis sample kitabi qeemat par ek dam (sharp) pighalta hai; milawati ek range mein.
2. Mixed melting point: khalis glucosazone ke saath mila kar dekhein; sharp aur wohi melting point ho to sample khalis hai.
3. Paper chromatography: khalis glucosazone ke saath chalayein; ek hi spot aur wohi Rf value pakeezgi dikhati hai.
Agar milawati ho to dobara crystallize kar ke phir test karein.

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 Differentiate simple distillation and fractional distillation in construction and applications.
Simple aur fractional distillation mein banawat aur istemal ke lihaz se farq bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Simple distillation mehlool se solvent alag karti hai (ya bohat mukhtalif boiling points wale liquids); fractional distillation mein fractionating column lagta hai jo qareeb boiling points wale miscible liquids alag karta hai.
Simple distillation (banawat): boiling chips wala distillation flask, burner se halka garam; thermometer; paani ka condenser (thanda paani neeche se andar, oopar se bahar); receiving flask. Bhaap seedhi condenser mein jati hai; distillate receiver mein jama hota hai aur residue flask mein rehta hai.
Fractional distillation (banawat): wohi set-up, magar flask aur condenser ke darmiyan glass beads se bhara fractionating (distillation) column, aur thermometer us ke oopar. Column mein bhaap baar baar condense aur phir bhaap banti hai. Temperature barhne par receiver badal dete hain (maslan ethanol 78 °C par, phir paani 100 °C par).

rows: Fractionating column nahi; bhaap seedhi condenser mein
Flask aur condenser ke darmiyan glass beads wala fractionating column
Ek dafa bhaap banna aur condense hona
Column mein baar baar condense aur bhaap banna
Hal shuda thos se solvent, ya door boiling points (taqreeban 25 °C ya zyada) wale liquids alag
Qareeb boiling points wale miscible liquids alag
Istemal: samandari paani se saaf paani; solvent hatana
Istemal: paani se ethanol; petroleum se petrol, diesel, kerosene, furnace oil

blocks.prompt:
Q.4 Describe the criterion to choose the suitable solvent in the process of crystallization?
Crystallization ke liye munasib solvent chunne ka mayaar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Crystallization ka usool yeh hai ke solute munasib solvent mein zyada temperature par hal ho aur thanda karne par zaid miqdar crystals ban kar nikal aaye. Is liye behtareen solvent:
1. Apne boiling point par substance ki bari miqdar aur kamre ke temperature par thori miqdar hal kare.
2. Solute se chemical reaction na kare.
3. Milawat ko ya to hal hi na kare, ya hal rakhe taake woh solute ke saath crystals na bane.
4. Thanda hone par khalis compound ke achhe bane crystals de.
5. Sasta, mehfooz aur crystals se aasani se hatne wala ho.
Aam solvents: paani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid. Agar koi akela solvent munasib na ho to do ya zyada miscible solvents ka mixture lete hain. Aag pakarne wala solvent shola par nahi, water bath par garam karte hain.
Solvent azmaish se chuna jata hai: thore substance ko mukhtalif solvents mein thanda aur garam check karte hain (chapter se aage).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 What is the basic principle of paper chromatography? Give its three practical life applications.
Paper chromatography ka bunyadi usool kya hai? Is ke teen amli istemal likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Usool: paper chromatography partition chromatography hai. Stationary phase paper ke cellulose fibres mein qaid paani hai aur mobile phase na milne wala organic solvent jo capillary action se paper par oopar chadhta hai (ascending tareeqa). Mixture ka har component dono phases mein apne tanasub se taqseem hota hai, is liye components mukhtalif rafttar se chal kar alag spots banate hain. Har ek ki muqarrar Rf value hai:
Rf = original spot se component ka tay kiya faasla ÷ original spot se solvent ka tay kiya faasla
Wohi stationary aur mobile phases hon to kisi cheez ki Rf value hamesha ek hi rehti hai.
Amli istemal:
1. Pakeezgi check karna: khalis cheez ek spot, milawati zyada spots deti hai (maslan aspirin ko khalis aspirin aur salicylic acid ke saath chalana).
2. Dyes, dawaiyon aur pesticides jaise pecheeda chemicals ki pehchan, maloom samples se Rf values mila kar; maslan mashkook jaali kaghaz ki siyahi check karna.
3. Organic synthesis mein products ko alag aur saaf karna, aur qualitative aur quantitative analysis (maslan ninhydrin se amino acids nazar aane wale banana).
